Report written to `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/SFCC-89_PR57-takeover-report.md` (671 lines). Repo untouched, working tree clean.

## The adjudicated conflicts

**Shadowing — ONE mechanism (3-to-1 against the majority).** Three of the four audits and the base findings say "two mechanisms, deleting the route entry doesn't fix it." I re-derived it from source: `OverridesResolverPlugin.isFromExtends` returns `this.extends.includes(pkgName) && !filepath.includes(issuerPath)`, and base `routes.jsx:43`'s specifier is *relative* (`'./pages/product-detail'`), so it never matches. Confirmed on the built and *deployed* artifact — `pages-product-detail.js` carries override markers (`ZimmPdpProductInfo`) **and** base-only markers (`HTTPNotFound`, `useServerContext`). **Deleting `overrides/app/routes.tsx:37-40` is the whole fix.** The breadcrumb is the opposite case and the findings have it right — both base consumers import by package specifier, so the PLP really is restyled.

**`var(--zimm-*)` — 9 lines, not 8, and 3 are correct.** `theme/index.ts` registers `space` but not `sizes`, so `product-detail:69-71` (`Skeleton height`) *must* use `var()`. Any list saying "move all 8 into the recipe" ships a layout bug — that instruction is in the base findings §10 and in `audit-zimmlead`. Also: `breadcrumb:33`/`zimmPageToolbar:58` are *motion* tokens, a different class — they want the `motion` constant import, not a recipe move.

**`ui-kits` — both audits are right about different questions.** Styling surface: settled *and* citable via `.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md`. Directory layout: decided in practice, **no repo rule on `develop`** (11 rules files, no `uikit-components.md`, no `overrides.md`). Do not merge the f2r `uikit-components.md` — it forbids Chakra in ui-kit files. But don't reject it wholesale either: its Chakra-mangles-font-family finding is already implemented as `theme/zimmTokensGlobal.tsx`.

**`auditTokenUsage.mjs` — citable.** `.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md` mandates it; `ls scripts/` shows it doesn't exist. Repo file, so raisable normally.

**C7 (fonts) is wrong and I corrected it.** `frozenFiles.md:27` on HEAD and `develop` says "**No font binaries in this repo.**" The "self-hosted" wording C7 quotes exists only on `feature/SFCC-55_global-footer-ui`. The Tier 1 file is *correct*; the operative conclusion (no type metric was ever validated) survives.

## The thing nobody found

**No page is server-rendered on any route, on any tier I could reach.** `/`, `/product/*`, `/category/*`, `/search`, `/login` — all HTTP 200 with a Chakra `Spinner` in `<main>`, on the PR-57 preview *and* the `test` tier, identical under curl/Chrome/Googlebot. The shell renders; page components fall back. The preview *is* running this PR's code (served chunk byte-identical to my local build).

Two consequences: it's a pre-existing, storefront-wide SEO/LCP defect for Integration (Tier 1 `ssr.js` — don't touch), and **it kills the "nobody opened the preview" charge**. `audit-fedlead` R1/R2/G6 claim a one-minute preview check would have found the blocker. It would have shown a spinner on the PDP and on the homepage — indistinguishable.

## Do now (decision-independent)

`npm run lint:fix` (5 errors, all this branch) · `data-testid` on `pdpProductInfo:32` · guard the unconditional `h1`/`price` in the atom, not the page's `?? ''` · i18n the 4 strings · `motion` constants for `breadcrumb:33`/`zimmPageToolbar:58` · move `index.test.ts` → `utils/productData.test.ts` + attributed-`<li>` and non-English cases · **back the `generateRegistry.mjs` Squad A move out** · reply to all 8 CodeRabbit threads · write `ZimmBreadcrumb`/`ZimmPageToolbar` recipes (namespace them — base ships a `Breadcrumb` recipe) · fix the PR body's 5 stale claims. Explicitly **not** in this bucket: `:69-71`, and the 32→30px / 360→218px values (decision #1 may replace that grid).

Two other useful corrections: **`react-helmet` is already in the tree** as a `retail-react-app` dependency and base ships `app/components/seo` — SEO needs zero new packages. And **jsdom is not in `vendor.js`** (0 refs) — the 95.4% budget figure is not this dependency's fault, and the package's own browser entry is jsdom-free, so "keep it, sanitise post-hydration" beats "remove it."
